subject: Agriculture
title: Variable Rate Application
description: A quick, practical guide to Variable Rate Application.

hook.text: Not every square meter of a field needs the same fertilizer. Variable rate tech applies more where soil is poor.

buildup.text: Traditionally, farmers applied fertilizer uniformly—blanket spreading the same rate across every field.

discovery.text: Soil sensors and yield maps reveal enormous variation within a single field—pH, nutrients, and moisture change dramatically.

twist.text: Variable rate application cuts fertilizer use by 15–20% while maintaining yield. Less runoff into waterways.

climax.text: Prescription maps—created from soil data—tell the spreader exactly how much to apply at every point in the field.

punchline.text: Feed each plant what it needs. No more, no less. Precision replaces guesswork.

quiz.question: How much can variable rate application reduce fertilizer use?
